You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def sim(I,launch_dir):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    tw=[i for i,r in enumerate(I) if 2 in r][0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4 and i!=tw]
    if not seeds: return O
    s=seeds[0]; di,dj=launch_dir
    # treat 2-row as mirror: bouncing off it flips vertical component; walls flip horizontal
    r,c=s; path=[]
    seen=set()
    while True:
        state=(r,c,di,dj)
        if state in seen: break
        seen.add(state); path.append((r,c))
        nr,nc=r+di,c+dj
        # 2-row blockage/mirror
        if tw<nr<H and all(I[tw][k]==2 for k in range(W)):
            # moving into 2-row: reflect vertical, stay in row? try bounce: reflect di
            di=-di
            nr=r+di
        elif nr<0 or nr>=H: di=-di; nr=r+di
        elif nc<0 or nc>=W: dj=-dj; nc=c+dj
        if not (0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        r,c=nr,nc
    for p in path: O[p[0]][p[1]]=4
    return O

def eq(a,b): return a==b
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    dirs=[(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]
    good=[d for d in dirs if sim(I,d)==O]

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def billiard(grid,start_dir,stop_at_origin=True,maxsteps=10**6):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0]); tw=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if 2 in r][0]
    # travel space excludes the 2-row: ball cannot occupy cells in row tw. When attempting to cross it, reflect vertical comp.
    dr,dj=start_dir; r,c=0,0  # will be set
    path=[]
    seen_states=set()
    for _ in range(maxsteps):
        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dj
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        if grid[nr][nc]==2:
            # would enter 2-row: reflect vertical component
            dr=-dr; continue
        r,c=nr,nc
        state=(r,c,dr,dj)
        if state in seen_states:
            if stop_at_origin: return None  # loop without covering
        seen_states.add(state)
        path.append((r,c))
    return path

    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0]); tw=[i for i,r in enumerate(I) if 2 in r][0]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    extra=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(O) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    found=[]
    for si,sj in seeds:

                # require: every extra cell on path, every path cell is extra-or-seed
                ok=all((e in extra or e==(si,sj)) for e in p) and all(e in extra for e in extra)
                # path must cover all extra cells

import os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

# Collect (seed, output-extra-cells-relative-to-seed) for each demo, ignoring the 2-row region
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    tw=[i for i,r in enumerate(I) if 2 in r][0]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4 and i!=tw]
    extra=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(O) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4 and i!=tw]
    print('=== demo',n,'H,W,tw=',len(I),len(I[0]),tw)
    for si,sj in seeds:
        rel=sorted(set((i-si,j-sj) for i,j in extra))
        # remove cells belonging to other seeds' trails? just print
        print('  seed',(si,sj),'rel-out:',rel)
